Beta-series covariance slopes use trial-level estimates as input. This example
is descriptive; beta-estimation uncertainty and the legacy beta-permutation
null have not been qualified.

```{r}
library(multiPPI)
set.seed(101)
B <- matrix(rnorm(40 * 4), 40, 4)
P <- cbind(condition = rep(c(0, 1), 20))
fit <- mppi_fit_beta(B, P)
fit$Delta[[1]]
```
